verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe a Segment as a saved filter that automatically adds people when they match its criteria and removes them when they stop matching, so segments stay live as data changes. The docs also advertise a custom segment builder with unlimited conditions and filters, and say events help you build better segments. Fields and tags are documented as profile data, but the evidence does not explicitly confirm they can be used as segment conditions. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing segment conditions combining profile fields, tags, and event criteria; independent or hands-on corroboration of live segment behavior.
